slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about the timing of purchases within a month. The closest question was about whether capacity applies at end or beginning of month, which concerns inventory timing, not purchase timing.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases occur before sales within each month, as implied by the inventory balance I_m = I_{m-1} + x_m - s_m and the capacity constraint I_m ≤ 500.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked or confirmed when purchases occur relative to sales; the model silently assumes beginning-of-month purchases.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL without resolving the P1 hidden slot about purchase timing within the month.

summary: The agent asked several useful clarifying questions about continuous variables, purchase/sales limits, capacity timing, and end-of-horizon inventory, but missed the P1 hidden slot on when purchases occur within the month and silently assumed beginning-of-month purchases in its final model.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
